C.L.E.A.R.+
C=Context and Goal
L=Limits and Negative Constraints
E=Expected Output
A=Audience
R=Role and Process
+=Iteration and Verification

ITERATION_LOOP
1 Diagnose failed field
2 Isolate one variable
3 Constrain with exclusions and verification checks

FACILITATOR_RULES
- Keep segment boundaries strict.
- Ask "what assumption is still unconstrained?" every 10-15 min.
- Require pass/fail criteria before accepting final outputs.

- framework naming must be C.L.E.A.R.+
- negative constraints included in examples
- before/after prompt rewrite included
- iteration loop explicit
